name: Greg Gianforte
stance: Signed the Right to Compute Act limiting government restrictions on computation, which also requires a human-control shutdown mechanism for AI-controlled critical infrastructure.

statements.text: Signed SB 212, the Right to Compute Act, which protects private use of computational resources and requires AI-controlled critical infrastructure to have a shutdown mechanism reverting to human control.
